questions.text: What were Kamila's symptoms when she woke up on Monday?
opts: Headache, sore throat, fever, blocked nose, and cough
questions.correct: Headache, sore throat, fever, blocked nose, and cough
questions.hint: Paragraph 1: all 5 symptoms are listed.

questions.text: The WKU medical centre is on the ground floor of Building 3.
questions.hint: "Located on the ground floor of Building 3."

questions.text: What was Dr. Akhmetov's diagnosis?
questions.hint: "You have got a viral respiratory infection."

questions.text: Kamila had to stay home for at least ___ days.
questions.hint: "You absolutely have to stay home for at least three days."

questions.text: What two medicines did the doctor prescribe?
questions.hint: "An antiviral tablet and a throat spray."

questions.text: Kamila had to go to hospital.
questions.hint: "You don't have to go to hospital — this is not that serious."

questions.text: How much water did the doctor tell Kamila to drink daily?
questions.hint: "Drink at least two litres of water per day."

questions.text: Who helped Kamila recover?
questions.hint: "Her roommate Zhibek took very good care of her."

questions.text: What is wrong with Amir when he calls the clinic?
opts: He has a stomachache and has been sick
questions.correct: He has a stomachache and has been sick
questions.hint: "I've got a bad stomachache and I've been sick twice this morning."

questions.text: What did Amir eat the previous night?
opts: Chicken shawarma from a street stall
questions.correct: Chicken shawarma from a street stall
questions.hint: "I had a chicken shawarma from the street stall near the gates."

questions.text: Dr. Nurova prescribes antibiotics for Amir.
questions.hint: "No, you don't have to — it's not bacterial."

questions.text: Amir must avoid solid food for ___ hours.
questions.hint: "You must avoid solid food for 24 hours."

questions.text: What can Amir drink? (3 options)
questions.hint: "Only water, herbal tea, and clear soup."

questions.text: Dr. Nurova tells Amir to go to hospital.
questions.hint: "No, you don't have to go to hospital."

questions.text: She ___ a fever of 39 and a sore throat.
questions.hint: She → has got (3rd person).

questions.text: I ___ any allergies — the doctor asked and I confirmed.
questions.hint: I → haven't got (negative).

questions.text: "He have got food poisoning" — what is wrong?
questions.hint: He/She/It → has got (not "have got").

questions.text: "I've got 20 years old" is correct English.
questions.hint: Age uses "be": I am 20 years old. Never "have got".

questions.text: She ___ stay home for three days. (Doctor's order)
questions.hint: Doctor's order = obligation. She (3rd person) = has to.

questions.text: What is the difference between "don't have to" and "must not"?
opts: "don't have to" = not necessary; "must not" = forbidden
questions.correct: "don't have to" = not necessary; "must not" = forbidden
questions.hint: Critical distinction: optional vs forbidden.

questions.text: You ___ go to hospital — the doctor said it's not serious enough.
questions.hint: Not necessary = don't have to.

questions.text: What is the past form of "have to"?
questions.hint: Past of have to → had to (all persons).

questions.text: What does "diagnosis" mean?
questions.hint: Diagnosis = the identification of an illness by a doctor.

questions.text: Her throat was red and ___ — it needed treatment immediately.
questions.hint: Inflamed = red, swollen, and painful.

questions.text: What is a "prescription"?
opts: A written order from a doctor for medicine
questions.correct: A written order from a doctor for medicine
questions.hint: Prescription = written order from doctor for medicine.

questions.text: "Exhausted" means slightly tired.
questions.hint: Exhausted = EXTREMELY tired, having no energy at all.

questions.text: Where do you go to collect your prescribed medicine?
questions.hint: Pharmacy = a shop where medicines are prepared and sold.

questions.text: The process of becoming well again after illness is called ___.
questions.hint: Recovery = the process of becoming well again.

questions.text: What does "infection" mean?
opts: An illness caused by bacteria or virus
questions.correct: An illness caused by bacteria or virus
questions.hint: Infection = illness caused by bacteria or a virus.

questions.text: "Sore" describes...
opts: something that is painful and uncomfortable
questions.correct: something that is painful and uncomfortable
questions.hint: Sore = painful and uncomfortable. e.g. a sore throat, sore muscles.
